computedRatios.definitionExcerpt: " Consolidated Total Net Leverage Ratio " means, as of any date of determination, the ratio of (a) the sum of (i) Consolidated Funded Indebtedness as of such date, minus (ii) Designated Cash as of such date in excess of $5,000,000, to (b) Consolidated EBITDA for the Measurement Period most recently completed on or prior to such date.

thresholds.citationExcerpt: (l) any other Investment; provided , that , (i) no Default has occurred and is continuing or would result therefrom, and (ii) upon giving Pro Forma Effect to such Investment, (A) the Consolidated Total Net Leverage Ratio recomputed as of the most recent fiscal quarter end for which the Borrower was required to deliver financial statements pursuant to Section 6.01(a) or Section 6.01(b) , as applicable, shall not exceed 3.00 to 1.00 (i.e. 0.50 less than the maximum Consolidated Total Net Leverage Ratio permitted under Section 7.11(a) as of the end of such fiscal quarter) and (B) the Loan Parties would be in compliance with the financial covenant set forth in Section 7.11(b) as of the most recent fiscal quarter end for which the Borrower was required to deliver financial statements pursuant to Section 6.01(a) or Section 6.01(b) , as applicable;

(c) the Borrower may make any Restricted Payment; provided , that , (i) no Default has occurred and is continuing or would result therefrom, and (ii) upon giving Pro Forma Effect to such Restricted Payment, (A) the Consolidated Total Net Leverage Ratio recomputed as of the most recent fiscal quarter end for which the Borrower was required to deliver financial statements 120 pursuant to Section 6.01(a) or Section 6.01(b) , as applicable, shall not exceed 3.00 to 1.00 (i.e. 0.50 less than the maximum Consolidated Total Net Leverage Ratio permitted under Section 7.11(a) ) as of the end of such fiscal quarter and (B) the Loan Parties would be in compliance with the financial covenant set forth in Section 7.11(b) as of the most recent fiscal quarter end for which the Borrower was required to deliver financial statements pursuant to Section 6.01(a) or Section 6.01(b) , as applicable;

computedRatios.definitionExcerpt: " Consolidated Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio " means, as of any date of determination, the ratio of (a) the total of (i) Consolidated EBITDA for the Measurement Period most recently completed on or prior to such date, minus (ii) Consolidated Maintenance Capital Expenditures for such period, to (b) the sum of (i) Consolidated Interest Charges to the extent paid in cash for the Measurement Period most recently completed on or prior to such date, plus (ii) Consolidated Scheduled Funded Debt Payments for such period, plus (iii) Consolidated Cash Taxes for such period, plus (iv) the aggregate amount of all Designated Restricted Payments made in such period; provided , that , for purposes of calculating the Consolidated Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio as of the end of each of the first four (4) fiscal quarters ending after the Cantaloupe Acquisition Funding Date, (x) the determination of Consolidated Interest Charges (1) in respect of Indebtedness under this Agreement and the Existing Credit Agreement, shall be Consolidated Interest Charges under this Agreement determined on an annualized basis from the Cantaloupe Acquisition Funding Date, which, for the avoidance of doubt, shall be calculated by dividing the amount of such Consolidated Interest Charges by the number of days since the Cantaloupe Acquisition Funding Date and multiplying by three hundred sixty-five (365), and (2) in respect of all other Indebtedness (including Indebtedness of Cantaloupe and its Subsidiaries that is not refinanced on the Cantaloupe Acquisition Funding Date with Indebtedness under this Agreement), shall be the actual Consolidated Interest Charges in respect of such Indebtedness, (y) the determination of Consolidated Scheduled Funded Debt Payments (1) in respect of Indebtedness under this Agreement and the Existing Credit Agreement, shall be deemed to include a scheduled principal payment on the Term Loans pursuant to Section 2.07(a) and (b) in each such fiscal quarter on the aggregate principal amount of the Term Loans advanced on the Closing Date and the aggregate principal amount of the Term Loans advanced on the Cantaloupe Acquisition Funding Date and (2) in respect of all other Indebtedness (including Indebtedness of Cantaloupe and its Subsidiaries that is not refinanced on the Cantaloupe Acquisition Funding Date with Indebtedness under this Agreement), shall be made on an annualized basis from the Cantaloupe Acquisition Funding Date, which, for the avoidance 12 of doubt, shall be calculated by dividing the amount of such Indebtedness by the number of days since the Cantaloupe Acquisition Funding Date and multiplying by three hundred sixty-five (365), and (z) the determination of Designated Restricted Payments (1) in respect of Designated Restricted Payments constituting Restricted Payments under clause (a) of the definition thereof made by the Borrower or any of its Subsidiaries (including Cantaloupe and its Subsidiaries), shall be such Designated Restricted Payments determined on an annualized basis from the Cantaloupe Acquisition Funding Date, which, for the avoidance of doubt, shall be calculated by dividing the amount of such Designated Restricted Payments by the number of days since the Cantaloupe Acquisition Funding Date and multiplying by three hundred sixty-five (365) , and (2) in respect of any other Designated Restricted Payments made by the Borrower or any of its Subsidiaries (including Cantaloupe and its Subsidiaries), shall be the actual amount of such Designated Restricted Payments made by the Borrower or any of its Subsidiaries (including Cantaloupe and its Subsidiaries).

Directly or indirectly enter into any Sale and Leaseback Transaction. 7.15 Prepayments, Etc. of Indebtedness . Directly or indirectly prepay, redeem, purchase, defease or otherwise satisfy any Indebtedness (other than Intercompany Debt) that (x) is subordinated in right of payment to the Secured Obligations or (y) secured by a Lien on the Collateral junior to the Liens created under the Collateral Documents (“ Junior Indebtedness ”) prior to the scheduled maturity thereof in any manner (including by the exercise of any right of setoff) or make any payment of Junior Indebtedness in violation of any subordination, standstill or collateral sharing terms of or governing any such Junior Indebtedness (each a “ Restricted Debt Payment ”), except for (i) a permitted refinancing of any such Junior Indebtedness not prohibited by Section 7.02 ; (ii) a Restricted Debt Payment to the extent made solely with the Equity Interests of the Borrower; and (iii) any other Restricted Debt Payment; provided, that, (A) no Default shall have occurred and be continuing at the time thereof or would result therefrom, and (B) the aggregate amount of all such Restricted Debt Payments made in reliance on this Section 7.15 during the term of this Agreement shall not exceed $10,000,000. 7.16 Amendment, Etc. of Indebtedness . Directly or indirectly amend, modify or change in any manner any term or condition of any Indebtedness having an aggregate outstanding principal amount in excess of the Threshold Amount (other than Indebtedness arising under the Loan Documents) if such amendment, modification or change would add or change any terms in a manner materially adverse to any Loan Party or any Subsidiary. 7.17 Sanctions . Directly or knowingly indirectly use any Credit Extension or the proceeds of any Credit Extension, or lend, contribute or otherwise make available such Credit Extension or the proceeds of any Credit Extension to any Person, to fund any activities of or business with any Person, or in any Designated Jurisdiction, that, at the time of such funding, is the subject of Sanctions, or in any other manner that will result in a violation by any Person (including any Person participating in the transaction, whether as Lender, Arranger, Administrative Agent, L/C Issuer, Swingline Lender, or otherwise) of Sanctions. 7.18 Anti-Corruption Laws . Directly or knowingly indirectly use any Credit Extension or the proceeds of any Credit Extension for any purpose which would breach the United States Foreign Corrupt Practices Act of 1977, the UK Bribery Act 2010 and other similar anti-corruption legislation in other jurisdictions. 7.19 PACA . Directly or indirectly (a) modify any payment terms or requests for payment with respect to produce or other perishable agricultural commodities capable of being subject to PACA in any manner to void PACA rights and benefits available to any Loan Party, or (b) take any other action to void the rights or benefits available to any Loan Party under PACA with respect to produce or other perishable agricultural commodities capable of being subject to PACA. 123 7.20 Outbound Investment Rules . Directly or indirectly (a) be or become a “covered foreign person”, as that term is defined in the Outbound Investment Rules, or (b) engage in (i) a “covered activity” or a “covered transaction”, as each such term is defined in the Outbound Investment Rules, (ii) any activity or transaction that would constitute a “covered activity” or a “covered transaction”, as each such term is defined in the Outbound Investment Rules, if such Loan Party or such Subsidiary were a United States Person, or (iii) any other activity that would cause the Administrative Agent, any Lender, the L/C Issuer or the Swingline Lender to be in violation of the Outbound Investment Rules or cause the Administrative Agent, any Lender, the L/C Issuer or the Swingline Lender to be legally prohibited by the Outbound Investment Rules from performing under this Agreement or any other Loan Document.
